status: preliminary; never use this register as safety signoff

hazards.name: Unintended motion
hazards.required_controls: independent inhibit; guards; deadman; selected mode

hazards.name: Gravity collapse/fall
hazards.required_controls: retained supports/brakes; qualified hoist/harness; drop-load analysis
hazards.closure_evidence: structural certificate and supported fault response

hazards.name: Stored electrical / battery energy
hazards.required_controls: approved current protection; isolation; thermal; no charging without design
hazards.closure_evidence: electrical inspection and measured fault response

hazards.name: Invalid friction or inertial model
hazards.required_controls: measured inertia and contact limits; harness
hazards.closure_evidence: stance/slip fault injection and instrumented support

hazards.name: Stale or inaccurate sensors
hazards.closure_evidence: clock drift, sensor dropout and freeze reports

hazards.name: Unsafe high-level instruction
hazards.required_controls: typed goals, permissions, independent safety gate
hazards.closure_evidence: adversarial prompt and command replay suite

hazards.name: Stop or restart defect
hazards.required_controls: independent latched stop, physical reset, self-test
hazards.closure_evidence: stop category validation and observed restart

hazards.name: Unreviewed self modification
hazards.required_controls: operator approval, source pinning, safety firmware isolation

hazards.name: Human enters robot envelope
hazards.required_controls: segregated test cell and protective sensors

hazards.name: Software/network compromise
hazards.required_controls: authenticated build, segment network, signed updates
